title: 15-Year-Old Tanvi Sharma Wins Maiden BWF World Tour Title
summary: 15-Year-Old Tanvi Sharma Wins Maiden BWF World Tour Title

items: 15-year-old **Tanvi Sharma** won maiden BWF World Tour title defeating Vietnam's Nguyen Thuy Linh.
Milestone: **First Indian woman to win the title since Saina Nehwal in 2008**.
